newsitem.title: USA: CST Entertainment names Shapiro chairman.
newsitem.headline: CST Entertainment names Shapiro chairman.

text.p: CST Entertainment Inc Friday named Jody Shapiro to the position of chairman.
In a statement, the company said the position has been vacant since Gerald Shefsky resigned on July 2, 1996.

In addition, Dr. Ramendra Singh, president of Dynacs Engineering Inc, has joined the board, replacing Abbey Butler, who resigned on October 29. Stephen Strick, senior vice president and secretary for CST, and Javier Benavente and Ravi Venugopal, both executives at Dynacs, have also been appointed, increasing the board from five to seven members.

Separately, the company said it has been informed by the American Stock Exchange of its intent to remove the listing of CST's common stock. CST said it has determined not to appeal this decision and the company expects to immediately begin trading on the NASD OTC Bulletin Board.
